blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 热相学在军事和更广泛的热分析应用中发挥着至关重要的作用. 3D热能重建的近期进展将温度分析从2D扩大到了3D空间,然而大部分现有作品都假定了静态温度分布,忽略了现实世界环境中热能转移的时间动态. 为解决这一局限性,我们提出了第一个动态RGB-热力重建框架,用于复杂场景. 我们的方法联合模型RGB外观,热观测, 和场景几何 随着时间的变化。 具体地说,我们采用了一种多模式动态场景代表,将颜色和热能模式固定在一个共享的几何底物上,确保它们在瞬间变形下的一致性。 我们进一步设计了多模式嵌入法,以加强每种模式的运动表达力,并提议一种多模式通路机制,保留一套统一的共享多模式高斯人作为几何中枢,同时适应性地培育出特定模式高斯人,以加强每种模式在细节丰富的区域的代表性能力。 此外,我们提供了一套新的基准数据,其中包含高频温度变化,以便于评价4D重建。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法实现了外观和温度的高性能的瞬间重建。 我们的代码和数据集可查阅:https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Temperature governs diverse natural and engineered processes. Thermal imaging converts surface temperature distributions into interpretable 2D observations and supports applications ranging from military surveillance ( He et al., 2021 ) and industrial analysis ( Glowacz, 2021 ) to architecture ( El Masri and Rakha, 2020 ) , search and rescue ( Yeom, 2024 ) , and medical diagnostics ( Lahiri et al., 2012 ) . In real-world environments, thermal fields evolve continuously and can change rapidly under convection, conduction, and radiation.
Existing 3D thermal field reconstruction methods characterize spatial geometry but do not effectively capture complex dynamic heat transfer. Therefore, extending thermal field reconstruction into the 4D spatiotemporal domain has become key to advancing this field.
blocks.zh:
温度控制着不同的自然和工程过程。 热成像将地表温度分布转化为可解释的2D观测,并支持从军事监视(He等,2021年)和工业分析(Glowacz,2021年)到建筑(El Masri和Rakha,2020年),搜索和救援(Yeom,2024年),以及医疗诊断(Lahiri等,2012年)等应用. 在现实世界环境中,热场会不断演化,并在对流,导电和辐射下能迅速变化.
现有的3D热场重建方法具有空间几何特征,但不能有效捕捉到复杂的动态热能传递. 因此,将热场重建扩展到4D相位元域成为推进此域的关键.

blocks.en:
Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) have significantly improved high-fidelity novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. Building on them, numerous studies ( Hassan et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024 ) target high-quality static 3D thermal field reconstruction. Recent methods further model temporal thermal evolution over RGB-derived or fixed scene geometry ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . They do not jointly reconstruct dynamic RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry in complex scenes with object motion and rapid temperature changes.
We address this setting with the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes.
blocks.zh:
近代神经辐射场(NERF)(Mildenhall等,2021年)和3D高斯平板机(3DGS)(Kerbl等,2023年)的进步,大大改善了高真度小说取景合成和3D重建. 在此基础上,许多研究(Hassan等,2024;Lin等,2024;Lu等,2024b;Chen等,2024)针对高质量的静态3D热场重建. 最近的方法进一步模拟了RGB衍生出或固定场地几何上的时热演化(刘等,2025;杨等,2025;王等,2026. 它们不会在有物体运动和快速温度变化的复杂场景中共同重建动态RGB外观,热观测和场景几何.
我们用第一个动态的RGB热能重建框架来应对这个环境,用于复杂场景.

blocks.en:
The lack of open-source thermal field reconstruction datasets has constrained progress in 4D thermal reconstruction. Existing benchmarks do not cover joint RGB-Thermal reconstruction in complex scenes where geometry and temperature change rapidly. To support research in this setting, we introduce DynamicRGBT-Scenes , a benchmark dataset for dynamic RGB-Thermal scene reconstruction with fast temperature changes.
DynamicRGBT-Scenes contains 12 synchronized dual-view RGB-Thermal sequences captured using two handheld device pairs, each consisting of a FLIR A700 thermal camera and an iPhone 15 Pro. The scenes include open-flame grilling, electric iron soldering, hair drying, and clothes ironing, among others. They cover rapid temperature changes, object motion, low light, and occlusion.
blocks.zh:
由于缺乏开源热场重建数据集,4D热能重建的进展受到限制. 现有的基准不包括在几何和温度迅速变化的复杂场景中RGB-热力联合重建. 为了支持这一背景下的研究,我们引入了动态RGBT-Scenses(DynamicRGBT-Scenses),这是动态RGB-热场重建的基准数据集,具有快温变化.
DynamicRGBT-Scense包含12个使用两个手持设备对捕获的同步双视RGB-热序,每个对对由一台FLIR A700热相机和一个iPhone 15 Pro组成. 场景包括开放放火烧烤,电铁焊接,干发等,以及熨衣服等. 它们覆盖了快速的温度变化,物体运动,低光,和被隔离.

blocks.en:
Representative 4D RGB methods include 4DGaussians ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , DN-4DGS ( Lu et al., 2024a ) , and E-D3DGS ( Bae et al., 2024 ) . Recent work further extends dynamic rendering to manipulation ( Li et al., 2025 ) , robotic ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and street scenes ( Wei et al., 2025b ) . The discrete 3DGS representation provides flexibility for complex topological changes. Extending these methods to thermal fields remains difficult because thermal images often lack texture and distinctive features, leading to unstable optimization.
To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal dynamic reconstruction framework that integrates thermal and RGB modalities. We build a unified Gaussian representation that preserves geometric consistency and temporal continuity, where each Gaussian encodes both color and thermal attributes.
We further introduce multimodal embeddings and dynamic deformation to model temporal evolution, along with a multimodal routing mechanism that separates shared and modality-specific Gaussians to enhance detail representation.
Comprehensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art dynamic thermal field reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
具有代表性的4D RGB方法包括:4DGaussians (Wu等,2024年),DN-4DGS (Lu等,2024年a),和E-D3DGS (Bae等,2024年). 最近的工作进一步扩大了动态渲染到操纵(Li等,2025年),机器人(Wang等,2025年),街景(Wei等,2025年b). 独立的3DGS代表制为复杂的地貌变化提供了灵活性. 将这些方法推广到热场仍然很困难,因为热成像往往缺乏纹理和特色,导致不稳定的优化.
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议建立一个多式联运动态重建框架,将热能模式和RGB模式结合起来。 我们建立了一个统一的高斯代表,保留了几何一致性和时间连续性,每个高斯人将颜色和热属性编码。
我们进一步引入了多模式嵌入和动态变形,以模拟时间演化,同时引入了将共享和模式特定的高斯人分开的多模式路由机制来增强细节的体现.
全面实验显示,我们的方法实现了最先进的动态热场重建.

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总而言之,主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: (1) We present DynamicRGBT-Scenes , the first benchmark to capture rapid thermal variations in dynamic environments with synchronized RGB–thermal image pairs from dual viewpoints.
blocks.zh: (1) 我们提出动态RGBT-Scenses,这是第一个从双重角度将同步RGB-热成像对捕获动态环境中快速热能变化的基准。

blocks.en: (2) We propose Dynamic Thermal Gaussians , the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes, rendering high-fidelity RGB and thermal views at any timestep.
blocks.zh: (2)我们提出"动态热能高斯人"(Dynamic Themal Gaussians),这是复杂场景的第一个动态RGB-热能重建框架,随时渲染出高纯度RGB和热能视图.

blocks.en: (3) We design multimodal embeddings and a progressive deformation architecture to model the distinct temporal evolution of each modality. We further integrate a learnable multimodal routing mechanism into the unified dynamic Gaussian representation to automatically distinguish shared and modality-specific Gaussians.
blocks.zh: (3) 我们设计了多模式嵌入和渐进变形结构,以模拟每一种模式在时间上的不同演变。 我们进一步将可学习的多模式路由机制纳入统一的动态高斯代表,以自动区分共享和模式特有的高斯人.

blocks.en: (4) Extensive experiments demonstrate that our multimodal method achieves state-of-the-art performance across both thermal and RGB modalities, establishing a solid foundation for spatiotemporal thermography.
blocks.zh: (4) 广泛的实验表明,我们的多式方法在热能和RGB两种方式中都实现了最先进的性能,为分相热能学奠定了坚实的基础。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Thermal Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1. 热场重建

blocks.en: Thermal imaging estimates surface temperature from infrared radiation emitted by objects, typically within the mid-wave or long-wave infrared spectrum. The resulting temperature distributions are commonly visualized using pseudo-color mapping. Since thermal measurements do not depend on visible illumination, thermal imaging can provide informative observations in low-light environments and under partial occlusion.
blocks.zh: 热成像估计出物体所发射出红外辐射的地表温度,一般在中波或长波红外光谱范围内. 由此产生的温度分布通常采用伪色绘图法进行可视化. 由于热能测量不依赖于可见光,热能成像可以在低光环境和被部分隔离的情况下提供信息性观测.

blocks.en: Multi-view thermal images enable 3D temperature analysis beyond fixed viewpoints. KinectFusion ( Newcombe et al., 2011 ) established dense surface mapping, and later systems added infrared observations ( Rangel et al., 2014 ; Müller, 2019 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . These static methods lack photorealistic novel-view synthesis and adapt poorly across thermal conditions. ThermoNeRF ( Hassan et al., 2024 ) , Thermal-NeRF ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , and ThermalNeRF ( Lin et al., 2024 ) extend NeRF to static RGB-Thermal or thermal-only fields, but costly implicit representations limit real-time rendering and structural control.
blocks.zh: 多视热成像使得3D温度分析超越了固定视点. 基内克特融合 (Newcombe等人,2011年)建立了密集地地表测绘,后期系统增加了红外观测(Rangel等人,2014年;Müller,2019年;Li等人,2023年). 这些静态方法缺乏光现实主义小说-视觉合成,在热能条件下适应不良. 热能NERF(Hassan等,2024年),热能-NERF(Ye等,2024年),热能NERF(Lin等,2024年)将NERF延伸至静态RGB-热能或只热能场,但成本高昂的隐含表示限制了实时渲染和结构控制.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, recent work adopts 3DGS as a more efficient and explicit alternative. ThermalGaussian and ThermalGaussian++ ( Lu et al., 2024b ; Lu et al., 2026 ) align and render RGB and thermal views; Thermal3D-GS ( Chen et al., 2024 ) adds atmospheric and conductive priors for physical consistency; Veta-GS ( Nam et al., 2025 ) uses view-dependent deformation to improve thermal edges; and MMOne ( Gu and Wang, 2025 ) unifies multimodal inputs in 3DGS.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,最近的工作采用了3DGS作为更有效和更明确的替代办法。 热能Gausian和热能Gausian++ (Lu等,2024b;Lu等,2026)对齐并制取了RGB和热能视图;热能3D-GS(Chen等,2024)为物理一致性增加了大气和导电前导;Veta-GS(Nam等,2025)使用视向依赖变形来改进热能边缘;而MMOne(Gu和Wang,2025)统一了3DGS的多式输入.

blocks.en: Beyond static reconstruction, dynamic thermal reconstruction has also received increasing attention. ThermalGS ( Liu et al., 2025 ) models temporal thermal radiation with Gaussian geometry guided by an RGB mesh and semantic features. NTR-Gaussian ( Yang et al., 2025 ) predicts nighttime thermal evolution from learned thermodynamic parameters and numerical integration. ETGS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) assigns explicit thermal parameters to Gaussians and uses closed-form heat transfer to predict arbitrary timestamps. These methods model thermal evolution over RGB-derived or fixed geometry, whereas we jointly reconstruct time-varying RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry.
blocks.zh: 除了静态重建外,动态热能重建也得到越来越多的关注. 热能GS(Liu等,2025年)以RGB网格和语义特征为导线,以高斯几何为定时热辐射模型. NTR - 高斯语Name (Yang等,2025年)从所学热力学参数和数值融合中预测出夜间热演化. ETGS(Wang等,2026年)为高斯人指定了明确的热参数,并使用闭式热传导来预测任意的时间戳. 这些方法在RGB衍生出或固定几何模型上建模了热演化,而我们共同重建了时间变化的RGB外观,热观测,和场景几何.

blocks.en: 2.2. Dynamic Scene Rendering
blocks.zh: 2.2. 动态场景渲染

blocks.en: Early dynamic NeRF methods extend spatial representations over time ( Wei et al., 2024 ) . D-NeRF ( Pumarola et al., 2021 ) conditions a deformation field on time to model non-rigid motion. Nerfies ( Park et al., 2021a ) and HyperNeRF ( Park et al., 2021b ) use per-frame latent codes for canonical-space deformation, with HyperNeRF lifting the representation to higher dimensions for topology changes. HyperReel ( Attal et al., 2023 ) combines ray-conditioned sampling with a compact dynamic volume for efficient, high-quality 6-DoF video synthesis.
blocks.zh: 早期活性NERF方法随时间推移而扩展空间表示(Wei等,2024.). D-NERF (Pumorola等, 2021年) 以一个变形场为条件, 以模拟非刚性运动. Nerfies (Park等, 2021a)和HyperNeRF (Park等, 2021b) 使用每帧潜入代码来进行舟-空地变形,HyperNeRF为地貌变化将代表提升到更高的维度. Hyper Reel(Attal等,2023年)将射线条件取样与紧凑的动态体积相结合,以高效,高质量的6-DoF视频合成.

blocks.en: Beyond NeRF-based methods, explicit 3DGS representations support generalizable ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and sparse-view ( Lin et al., 2025 ) reconstruction, while their 4D extensions provide an efficient alternative to NeRF volume rendering ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025a ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . D-3DGS ( Yang et al., 2024 ) learns canonical time-dependent deformation for high-fidelity dynamic reconstruction. 4DGaussians ( Wu et al., 2024 ) combine spatiotemporal neural voxels with Gaussians for faster rendering with explicit structure. E-D3DGS ( Bae et al., 2024 ) uses per-Gaussian embeddings to drive dual-level deformation for complex motion and detail. Other methods use structured 4D Gaussians ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , denoised spatiotemporal aggregation ( Lu et al., 2024a ) , and lightweight predictors with entropy constraints ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) to improve appearance, stability, and storage, respectively.
blocks.zh: 除了基于NERF的方法外,明确的3DGS表示支持可通用性(Wu等人,2025年)和稀有视野(Lin等人,2025年)重建,而其4D扩展则为NERF容积渲染提供了高效的替代品(Huang等人,2024年;Wei等人,2025年a; Wei等, 2026). D-3DGS (Yang等, 2024) 为高纯度活性重建学习犬科依赖时间变形. 4DGausians(Wu等,2024年)将spatiopal神经元与高斯神经元结合来进行更快速的渲染并有明显的结构. 电子D3DGS (Bae等,2024年) 使用per-Gausian嵌入来驱动双层变形,用于复杂的运动和细节. 其他方法使用结构化的4D高斯人(Yang等,2023年),去诺化的spatiotal聚合(Lu等,2024年a),并使用有肽约束的轻量级预测器(Zhang等,2025年)来分别改善外观,稳定性和存储性.

blocks.en: These methods reconstruct dynamic geometry and appearance from RGB observations but omit thermal measurements. Dynamic Thermal Gaussians instead integrates RGB and thermal supervision in one dynamic Gaussian representation for complex scenes.
blocks.zh: 这些方法从RGB观测中重建了动态几何和外观,但省略了热量测量. 动态热高斯人转而将RGB和热导集为一个动态高斯人代表,用于复杂的场景.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , we construct Dynamic Thermal Gaussians, a unified framework for multimodal dynamic reconstruction. Multimodal Dynamic Modeling (Section 3.2 ) combines shared canonical Gaussian geometry with modality-specific attributes; Multimodal Embedding-Based Deformation (Section 3.3 ) models dynamic variations using temporal and modality-specific Gaussian embeddings; and Multimodal Routing Mechanism (Section 3.4 ) adaptively assigns Gaussians to different modality roles.
blocks.zh: 如图1所显示的,我们构建了动态热能高斯人,这是多式联运动态重建的统一框架。 多式联运动态模型(第3.2节)将共享的舟子高斯几何与模式特有属性相结合; 多式联运嵌入-基于变形(第3.3节)利用时间和模式特有高斯嵌入模式模拟动态变化; 多式联运出行机制(第3.4节)因地制宜地赋予高斯人不同的模式角色.

blocks.en: 3.1. Preliminary
blocks.zh: 3.1. 初步情况

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) is an explicit representation for 3D reconstruction and rendering that models a scene with anisotropic 3D Gaussians. Each Gaussian jointly represents geometry, opacity, and view-dependent appearance. The fully differentiable formulation supports end-to-end optimization, while splatting provides efficient rasterization-style rendering.
blocks.zh: 3D高斯平板(3DGS)(Kerbl等,2023年)是3D重建的明显表现,并让该模型成为有异构3D高斯平板的场景. 每个高斯人共同代表几何,不透明,并依赖取景外观. 完全不同的配体支持端到端优化,而镀层则提供高效的光栅化风格渲染.

blocks.en: 3.2. Multimodal Dynamic Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2. 多式联运动态模型

blocks.en: To jointly model multimodal dynamic observations (e.g., RGB and thermal) within a unified 3D Gaussian representation while capturing modality-specific temporal imaging variations, we introduce a multimodal dynamic Gaussian representation. This formulation explicitly encodes modality-specific attributes into the Gaussian representation under the premise of maintaining multimodal geometric consistency and temporal continuity. It serves as a unified representational foundation for subsequent multimodal deformation modeling and training.
blocks.zh: 为了在一个统一的3D高斯代表制中联合模拟多模式动态观测(如RGB和热能),同时捕捉特定模式的时间成像变化,我们引入了多模式动态高斯代表制. 这种提法在维持多式几何一致性和时间连续性的前提下,将模式特定属性明确编码入高斯代表. 它为随后的多模式变形模型和培训提供了统一的代表基础。

blocks.en:
In dynamic multimodal scenes, different sensing modalities may exhibit substantially different imaging mechanisms. However, at any given timestamp, they observe the same underlying physical scene.
Therefore, we design a shared geometric representation for all modalities. Each 3D Gaussian G i G_{i} is parameterized by its mean position μ i \mu_{i} and covariance Σ i \Sigma_{i} , represented via rotation R i R_{i} and scale S i S_{i} . These geometric parameters are shared across all modalities and serve as a common reference coordinate system for time-dependent deformation. This shared canonical space enforces spatial alignment between modalities and ensures that temporal updates remain geometrically consistent.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Gaussian deformation fields have been shown to be effective for modeling dynamic scenes ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Bae et al., 2024 ) . In this formulation, temporal variations are modeled as continuous transformations in the canonical Gaussian space, rather than constructing independent representations for each timestamp, which enforces temporal coherence and improves modeling stability.
However, existing approaches predominantly focus on single-modality observations and do not explicitly account for the heterogeneous deformation behaviors induced by different sensing modalities.

We further introduce a progressive, modality-separated deformation architecture to capture modality-dependent dynamics under shared geometric constraints.

The time embeddings encode the temporal evolution in dynamic scenes and serve as a shared global condition across modalities. For each timestamp t t , every Gaussian is associated with a time embedding e t ∈ ℝ 128 e_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{128} to guide its continuous temporal evolution.

Combined with residual parameterization and a progressive modality-aware deformation strategy, this design models multimodal dynamics while preserving modality-specific deformation paths, reducing cross-modal interference, and improving modeling stability. blocks.en: 3.4. Multimodal Routing Mechanism
blocks.zh: 3.4. 多式联运机制

blocks.en: Building upon the unified geometry and modality-specific attributes, a remaining key question is determining which regions should be shared across modalities and which should be dominated by a single modality within a unified dynamic Gaussian representation. Forcing every Gaussian to participate in all modalities may introduce unnecessary coupling, while fully separating geometry would break spatial consistency and temporal continuity. To address this, we introduce a multimodal routing mechanism in the shared canonical space, enabling Gaussians to form shared and modality-specific structures adaptively under unified geometric constraints.

blocks.en: Therefore, the modality routing mechanism only regulates the participation contributions of Gaussians across modalities, without altering geometric evolution or multimodal deformation.

blocks.en: Because modality routing introduces discrete structural variables, allowing unrestricted specialization at early training stages may destabilize geometric convergence. We therefore adopt a progressive training strategy. In the initial stage, all Gaussians are treated as shared to ensure stable geometry learning and dynamic deformation modeling. As training proceeds, learnable routing variables are gradually activated, allowing modality preferences to emerge under reconstruction signals. In the specialization stage, routing assignments converge to stable shared and modality-specific regions under the joint influence of reconstruction objectives and global distribution constraints. In the final stage, routing assignments are fixed to ensure stable optimization and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 因为模式路由引入了离散的结构变量,允许在早期训练阶段不受限制地专业化,可能会破坏几何趋同. 因此,我们采取渐进的培训战略。 在初始阶段,所有高斯人被视作共享,以确保稳定的几何学和动态变形模型. 随着训练的进行,可学习的路由变量逐渐被激活,使得模式偏好在重建信号下出现. 在专业化阶段,在重建目标和全球分配制约的共同影响下,路线分配任务集中到稳定的共享和模式特定区域。 在最后阶段,确定路线分配,以确保稳定的优化和评价。

blocks.en:
Based on this design, we further extend the densification and pruning mechanism of 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) in a structure-consistent manner.
While the original densification and pruning operations rely solely on geometric gradients and opacity, we apply them separately for different structural roles during the specialization stage. Shared Gaussians follow the shared criteria, while rgb-only and thermal-only Gaussians are densified or pruned according to gradients computed from their respective modalities. Newly generated Gaussians inherit the structural role of their parent, preserving structural consistency.
blocks.zh:
基于这一设计,我们以结构一致的方式进一步扩大了3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)的密度和穿透机制.
虽然最初的密度和穿透操作完全依赖于几何梯度和不透明度,但我们在专业化阶段将它们分别用于不同的结构角色. 共享高斯人遵循共享标准,而只使用rgb和热能的高斯人则根据各自模式所计算的梯度进行密度或穿透. 新产生的高斯人继承了父母的结构性角色,保持了结构上的一致性.

blocks.en: This structure-consistent densification mechanism ensures that modality specialization is reflected not only in participation masks but also in spatial resolution allocation. RGB-dominant regions naturally acquire more rgb-only Gaussians, thermal-dominant regions accumulate more thermal-only Gaussians, and modality-consistent regions remain shared. As a result, routing variables correspond to explicit spatial structures rather than abstract probability weights, enhancing the interpretability of multimodal specialization.

blocks.en: 5.1. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1. 实施细节

blocks.en:
Our method builds upon E-D3DGS ( Bae et al., 2024 ) with the same optimization settings. Training starts from RGB-based sparse points and camera poses shared with synchronized thermal frames. Each iteration first updates geometry and RGB attributes in the RGB deformation stage, then geometry and thermal attributes under thermal supervision. All Gaussians remain shared for 1,000 iterations before the routing logits become learnable. Specialization starts after 10,000 iterations; at 20,000 iterations, routing assignments are fixed and densification stops. We set the temperature τ \tau to 1.0 and the routing-logit learning rate to 0.001. At inference, the target timestamp drives both deformation stages, routing masks select the Gaussians for each modality, and rendering from the target pose produces RGB and thermal outputs.
All methods are trained for 30,000 iterations on a single NVIDIA A5000 GPU. The resolution of both RGB and thermal images is 320 × \times 240.

blocks.en: We compare two representative baseline groups. ThermalGaussian ( Lu et al., 2024b ) and MMOne ( Gu and Wang, 2025 ) are static multimodal methods that jointly model RGB and thermal observations but do not handle dynamic scenes. D-3DGS ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , 4DGaussians ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and E-D3DGS ( Bae et al., 2024 ) are single-modality dynamic methods that model temporal variation without multimodal information. These groups cover static RGB-Thermal reconstruction and dynamic RGB reconstruction, providing relevant comparisons for our joint dynamic RGB-Thermal setting.

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 report thermal results. Our method achieves the best averages of 32.24 dB PSNR, 0.947 SSIM, and 0.119 LPIPS, exceeding the strongest dynamic baseline by 1.52 dB in PSNR. In dynamic scenes, static multimodal methods fit mixed temporal states rather than reconstructing a time-varying thermal field. Single-modality dynamic methods model temporal variation without complementary cross-modal information. Our method instead combines both modalities in a unified dynamic process and renders high-fidelity RGB and thermal images at arbitrary timesteps and viewpoints.

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on DynamicRGBT-Scenes to evaluate the contribution of each component. Table 3 reports results for the RGB and thermal modalities, using E-D3DGS(RGB/Thermal) as the corresponding baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们对动态RGBT-场景进行研究,以评估每个部分的贡献。 表3以E-D3DGS(RGB/热能)作为相应的基线,报告得出了RGB和热能模式的结果。

blocks.en: Starting from the modality-specific baselines, the shared multimodal Gaussian representation enables joint dynamic reconstruction of both modalities within a unified framework. This design improves RGB performance but slightly reduces thermal reconstruction quality. We then add multimodal embeddings to disentangle temporal codes and Gaussian embeddings across modalities. Both modalities improve, with thermal performance nearly matching its single-modality baseline. This result shows that the embeddings reduce feature coupling between heterogeneous modalities during joint modeling. Finally, multimodal routing consistently improves both modalities; for thermal reconstruction, it yields a clear PSNR gain of 1.52 dB.
blocks.zh: 从特定模式的基线开始,共同的多模式高斯代表制使两种模式都能够在统一的框架内共同进行动态重建。 这种设计提高了RGB的性能,但略微降低了热能重建的质量. 然后,我们添加了多模式嵌入法,以分散时间代码和高斯模式嵌入法。 这两种模式都有所改进,热能几乎与其单一模式基线相匹配。 这一结果表明,嵌入物减少了在联合建模过程中不同模式之间的特征结合. 最后,多式联运路线不断改进这两种方式;对于热能重建,它产生1.52分贝的明显的PSNR收益。

blocks.en: To analyze the spatial distribution induced by multimodal routing, Figure 5 projects sampled Gaussians from the HotWater scene onto RGB and thermal images. Shared Gaussians concentrate in regions with correlated cross-modal variation. RGB-only Gaussians mainly cover textured backgrounds with limited temperature variation and also cover some moving regions to preserve visual detail. In contrast, thermal-only Gaussians concentrate in regions with significant temperature changes, including hot water, flowing streams, and their boundaries. These observations show that multimodal routing effectively separates shared and modality-specific Gaussians, improving each modality’s capacity to model fine-grained regions. Overall, every component contributes positively; together, these gains support the effectiveness of the proposed multimodal dynamic reconstruction framework.
blocks.zh: 为了分析由多模式路由引起的空间分布,图5将高斯人从热水场景取样到RGB和热成像上. 共享的高斯人集中在具有相关跨模式变化的区域。 仅RGB-高斯人主要覆盖温度变化有限的纹理背景,并覆盖一些移动区域来保存视觉细节. 相形之下,只用热能的高斯人集中在温度有显著变化的地区,包括热水,流出流水,以及它们的边界. 这些观察表明,多式联运路线实际上将共享的和模式特有的高斯人分开,提高了每种方式对精细区域进行模型化的能力. 总体而言,每个组成部分都作出了积极贡献;这些收益共同支持拟议的多式联运动态重建框架的有效性。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present DynamicRGBT-Scenes, a benchmark for joint dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction, and Dynamic Thermal Gaussians, the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. The framework jointly models RGB and thermal modalities through a shared geometric representation, modality embeddings, and a structure-aware routing mechanism. Combined with a dynamic deformation strategy, it effectively decouples geometric motion from modality-specific variations, enabling stable reconstruction of rapidly evolving thermal fields and supporting novel-view synthesis at arbitrary timesteps and viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了"动态RGBT-Scens"(DynamicRGBT-Scens),作为联合动态RGB-热能重建的基准,以及"动态热能高斯人"(Dynamic Themal Gaussians),这是第一个用于复杂场景的动态RGB-热能重建框架. 该框架通过共享几何表达、模式嵌入和结构感通路机制,共同模拟RGB和热能模式。 它与动态变形策略相结合,有效地将几何运动与特定模式的变异脱钩,使迅速演化的热场得以稳定地重建,并支持在任意的时间步和观点下进行新视角合成.

blocks.en: The dataset’s synchronized high-frequency observations support 4D thermal analysis. Extensive experiments show state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and confirm the benefits of multimodal embeddings and adaptive routing for spatiotemporal thermography in real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 该数据集同步高频观测支持了4D热分析. 广泛的实验显示最先进的重建性能,并证实多式联运嵌入和适应路线在现实世界环境中用于瞬间热法的好处。
